environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an AWS Classic Load Balancer (CLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. No additional request filtering or inspection. The CLB performs SSL termination but does not inspect HTTP content. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.11, no additional middleware.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic Load Balancer, TCP mode
